verdicts.reason: Both are unusable: the hands photo, the heart of the original, is missing in each. A has the quote and attribution split far apart. The attribution floats alone on the right, a stray black bar pokes in at the top edge, and there is a stray tiny mark at the far right. B keeps the quote and attribution together as one centered block, with the attribution slightly larger and clearer. But B's text is tiny, there is a white cloud/plus fragment on the left that reads as a leftover artifact, and a black bar sits at the bottom edge. B is less bad because of its grouping and reading order.
